Assign replication states to G1 and genome windows

Source: R/replication_states.R
assign_replication_states.Rd

Run infer_single_cell_states() on every cell of a G1-window count matrix (in chunks of chunk_size cells, parallelised with BPPARAM), using the chromosome starts of g1_granges as HMM breakpoints, then project the states onto genome windows.

Usage

assign_replication_states(
  g1bins_matrix,
  g1_granges,
  genome_granges,
  gap_max_bp = 50000L,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(),
  chunk_size = 100L,
  infer_args = list(hmm_aggr_width = 15L, init_ratio_lower = 1.2, final_ratio_lower =
    1.4),
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

g1bins_matrix

A dgCMatrix of counts, G1 windows x cells, with row names identical to names(g1_granges) and non-NULL column names (e.g. define_G1_windows()$g1bins_counts).

g1_granges

GRanges of the G1 windows, grouped by chromosome, with a logical is_masked_window metadata column.

genome_granges

Named GRanges of genome windows, grouped by chromosome, with a logical is_mappable metadata column (e.g. from compute_bin_mappability()).

gap_max_bp

Maximum total width (bp) of an unmappable gap to fill.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam used over cell chunks.

chunk_size

Number of cells per chunk.

infer_args

Named list of extra arguments for infer_single_cell_states(). A list given here replaces the default as a whole; tune the values with evaluate_state_parameters().

verbose

Logical; print progress messages. Default FALSE.

Value

A list with

genobins_rep_states

Integer matrix, genome windows x cells, values 2, 4 or NA; input for compute_rep_percent().

g1bins_rep_states

Integer matrix, G1 windows x cells.

Details

States of masked G1 windows (mcols(g1_granges)$is_masked_window, NA counts as masked) are set to NA. Each genome window takes the state of the unmasked G1 window on the same chromosome with the largest overlap; unmappable genome windows (mcols(genome_granges)$is_mappable FALSE or NA) are set to NA, and runs of unmappable windows of at most gap_max_bp bp that are not at a chromosome end are filled when both flanking windows have the same state.
